احتفلنا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَلْنَا (iḥtafalnā) /iħ.ta.fal.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# اُحْتُفِلْنَا (uḥtufilnā) /uħ.tu.fil.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
